Icelandic original: „Það er ekki mikið af fólki svo þú getur verið einn með hugsunum þínum en samt ertu ekki einmanna vegna þess að fuglarnir syngja svo fallega.“
English gloss: “There are not many people so you can be alone with your thoughts but still you are not lonely because the birds sing so beautifully.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
